# Graphistry

> > GPU-accelerated graph visualization and analytics platform for security investigations, threat hunting, and fraud detection.

Graphistry provides visual graph analytics for security teams and data scientists, enabling rapid investigation and threat detection through GPU-powered visualization and automated playbooks. The platform integrates with major SIEM systems, data science tools, and cloud deployment options.

## Key Topics

- GPU-accelerated analytics
- Graph visualization
- Threat hunting
- Incident response
- SIEM integration
- Security investigation
- Visual playbooks
- PyGraphistry
- Splunk integration
- Network analysis
- Fraud detection
- Real-time rendering
- Apache Arrow
- Jupyter notebooks
- Cloud deployment

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://www.graphistry.com): Graphistry homepage showcasing GPU-accelerated graph analytics for SIEM and data visualization
- [How it Works](https://www.graphistry.com/how-it-works): Platform overview with GPU analytics, data connectors, and deployment options
- [Graph Analytics](https://www.graphistry.com/graph-analytics): GPU-accelerated graph analytics for investigation, threat hunting, and fraud detection
- [Investigate at Scale](https://www.graphistry.com/gpu): GPU-powered investigation platform with Apache Arrow and real-time rendering
- [Repeat and Automate](https://www.graphistry.com/visual-playbooks): Visual playbooks for automated investigation templates and threat detection

## Security Use Cases

- [Use Cases Overview](https://www.graphistry.com/use-cases): Overview of Graphistry use cases: incident response, threat hunting, SIEM optimization
- [Incident Response](https://www.graphistry.com/use-cases/incident-response): Graphistry for incident response with SIEM integration and threat analysis
- [Threat Hunting](https://www.graphistry.com/use-cases/threat-hunting): Threat hunting platform with graph visualization and notebook integration
- [SIEM Optimization](https://www.graphistry.com/use-cases/siem-optimization): SIEM optimization with Graphistry visual investigation and threat detection
- [Anti-Fraud](https://www.graphistry.com/use-cases/anti-fraud): Financial crime and fraud detection using graph analysis and link analysis

## Developer & Data Science

- [Developers](https://www.graphistry.com/developers): Developer APIs and integration options for React, JavaScript, and deployment
- [Data Science](https://www.graphistry.com/data-science): PyGraphistry for data scientists with GPU acceleration and Jupyter integration
- [Embed and Integrate](https://www.graphistry.com/embed-2): Integration guide for PyGraphistry, Jupyter, SageMaker, and Databricks
- [Graphistry for PowerBI](https://www.graphistry.com/graphistry-for-powerbi): Graphistry Custom Visual for PowerBI with GPU-accelerated graph visualization

## Documentation & Deployment

- [Documentation](https://www.graphistry.com/docs): Complete documentation for installation, APIs, Python, and administration
- [Get Started](https://www.graphistry.com/get-started): Getting started guide with pricing, deployment options, and account setup
- [Deploy](https://www.graphistry.com/deployment): Deployment options: Graphistry Cloud, AWS, Azure, GovCloud, and self-hosted
- [Connect Your Data](https://www.graphistry.com/connectors): Data connectors for SIEM, Elasticsearch, Splunk, and VirusTotal integration
- [Video Guides](https://www.graphistry.com/videos): Video tutorials for threat hunting, Splunk integration, and network analysis
